en.t: When the dance was over, the poems were read aloud.

units.source_text: 源氏公子所作精深渊博，宣读师亦不能轻易吟诵。

en.t: Prince Genji's composition was so profound and learned that even the reader could not recite it easily.

units.source_text: 每读一句，赞叹之声四起。

en.t: With each line that was read, voices of admiration rose on every side.

units.source_text: 诸文章博士亦皆真心感佩。

en.t: All the learned doctors of letters were sincerely moved with admiration as well.

units.source_text: 以前每逢此种机会，皇上必先使源氏公子表演，以为四座增光。

en.t: In the past, whenever such an occasion arose, the Emperor would always have Prince Genji perform first, bringing splendor to the whole gathering.

units.source_text: 今日赛诗得胜，圣心之喜悦自非寻常可比。

en.t: Since he had won today's poetry contest, the joy in His Majesty's heart was beyond any ordinary comparison.
